theme: A clear day, with tomorrow's recruiter call in view.

needsAttention.title: Recruiter intro with Amin Noorani
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow 9:30 AM Teams: your first call with Amin, the executive-search founder Jo Notkin connected you to. He already has your CV — arrive with two or three board targets and the governance story you want to lead with.

needsAttention.title: December trip — decision is due
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board (p2): shortlist was due Sept 30, booking by Oct 15. All four girls, Dec 13–Jan 2, over the thinnest holiday inventory of the year — a domestic pick can go out today.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Top priority on the board and three weeks past due: a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week, before holiday inventory sells out. Refundable now costs nothing and removes the whole risk.
